{{Nihongo|'''Mitsuhiro Yanagida''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|ForMemRS]]|柳田充弘|Yanagida Mitsuhiro|born April 4, 1941, in [[Tokyo]]}} is a Japanese [[molecular biologist]] known for research on [[cell cycle]] and [[chromosome structure]] using the fission yeast [[Schizosaccharomyces pombe]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/research/forefront/message/rakuyu04_a.htm | title = Mitsuhiro Yanagida | publisher = Kyoto University | access-date = 19 October 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nature.com/celldivision/advisors/index.html | title= Advisors | date= December 2001 | publisher = Nature Publishing Group | access-date = 19 October 2012}}</ref><ref name="pmid26447128">{{cite journal|author1=Hoffman CS |author2=Wood V |author3=Fantes PA. | title = An Ancient Yeast for Young Geneticists: A Primer on the ''Schizosaccharomyces pombe'' Model System.|journal = [[Genetics (journal)|Genetics]]| volume = 201| issue = 2| pages = 403–23|date=Oct 2015| pmid = 26447128 | doi = 10.1534/genetics.115.181503 | pmc=4596657}}</ref> He was elected as a foreign member of [[the Royal Society]] on 11 May 2000.

==Education and early life==
Yanagida was born in [[Tokyo]], and received his doctorate in science from the [[University of Tokyo]] in 1970. 

==Career and research==
He was Professor of [[Biophysics]] at [[Kyoto University]] from 1977 to 2004, where he served as Dean of Graduate School of Biostudies from 2001 to 2003. After retiring from Kyoto University and becoming Professor Emeritus, he has been Professor of the G0 Cell Unit at the [[Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology]].<ref>{{Cite press release | url = http://www.oist.jp/en/press-room/press-releases/40-2010/657-dr-mitsuhiro-yanagida-to-become-an-honorary-fellow-of-the-society-of-biology.html | title = OIST Principal Investigator Dr. Mitsuhiro Yanagida to Become an Honorary Fellow of the Society of Biology | publisher = Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology Graduate University | location = Okinawa, Japan | date = 27 September 2010 | access-date = 19 October 2012 | url-status = dead | archive-url = https://archive.today/20120906213201/http://www.oist.jp/en/press-room/press-releases/40-2010/657-dr-mitsuhiro-yanagida-to-become-an-honorary-fellow-of-the-society-of-biology.html | archive-date = 6 September 2012 }}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
[[File:Mitsuhiro Yanagida Isamu Akasaki Saiichi Nemura Toshiro Nara and Taichiro Mitani 20111103.jpg|thumb|200px|Yanagida received the [[Order of Culture]]. After that, they posed for the photo. (at the East Garden of the [[Tokyo Imperial Palace]] on November 3, 2011)]]
Yanagida is an Honorary Fellow of the [[Society of Biology]] since 2010<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/news_data/h/h1/news7/2010/100929_1.htm | title = Specially Appointed Professor Mitsuhiro Yanagida of the Graduate School of Biostudies received the title of Honorary Fellow of the Society of Biology | date = 29 September 2010 | access-date = 19 October 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url =https://groups.oist.jp/g0/mitsuhiro-yanagida | title = OIST G0 Cell Unit| date = 30 July 2012 | access-date = 30 July 2013}}</ref> and foreign associate of the [[National Academy of Sciences]], USA since 2012.<ref>[http://www.oist.jp/press-room/news/2012/5/2/oist%E2%80%99s-mitsuhiro-yanagida-elected-us-national-academy-sciences Prof. Mitsuhiro Yanagida elected to US National Academy of Sciences]</ref>

He received many awards including the [[Order of Culture]] (2011) and the [[Imperial Prize of the Japan Academy]] (2003).
